args.description: Context window in tokens; a value below 512 is raised to 512 with a notice.

args.name: src
args.description: Source language code.

args.name: dst
args.description: Target language code.

args.name: max-cost
args.description: Positive finite USD amount: the guard and the approval for a paid run. 0 means no limit, which the verb refuses together with --google; a negative, NaN or infinite value exits 10.

args.description: Nesting depth of the table of contents on index.html (0 = unlimited).

args.description: Output folder; default is beside the input. A caller that reads the result passes a fresh, empty folder (OCR-INVOCATION B2).

args.description: Rebuild even when a finished, current result exists; the converter only ever rebuilds a folder that carries its own record.

args.name: noopen
args.description: Do not open the browser afterwards; scripts always pass it (OCR-INVOCATION B1).

args.name: ui-lang
args.description: Language of the console text and of the converted page's navigation; default is the Windows UI language.

args.description: For a .fd-sec input: the NAME of an environment variable that holds its password, never the password. Without it the verb refuses (10) instead of asking.

args.name: result
args.description: Where to write the response data as one JSON file, written whole.

returns.name: complete

Several documents: one run per document. Only doc-html-translate.exe serves this verb; doc-html-ui.exe says so and exits 10.

commands.notes: This is the machine-readable capabilities query that OCR-INVOCATION section H.1 left open. It reports booleans, version numbers, extensions and language codes only - never a path, a document name or the Google key - and writes nothing. Without --ollama nothing is requested from any service; with it, one request goes to the local Ollama server and to no other. A tool's version is the number its own version query prints; FileDO has no such query and the pdftotext carried inside this program is not unpacked to be asked, so those two report an empty version. Without --json the data is printed as key: value lines. Both doc-html-translate.exe and doc-html-ui.exe answer this verb.

An existing target file is refused (exit 11, reason exists) without --overwrite.

commands.notes: The archive holds the environment summary and as many recent run logs as fit under 15 MiB, newest first, all redacted: no document name, key or personal path. Without --out it is written under the name DIAGNOSTIC-REPORT 8A gives it; with --out at the named file path, or inside an existing folder under the DIAGNOSTIC-REPORT 8A name (rule 9, item P.1, 0.3 item V), created or, with --overwrite, replaced whole through a temporary file. A path ending in a separator is a folder argument and a missing folder is never created. Each run is a new archive. Nothing is sent anywhere. Served by doc-html-translate.exe only.

commands.notes: Writes per-user keys under HKCU only, needs no elevation and changes no default handler. Started with no arguments the program offers this and default-handler set as two y/N questions, read from standard input by a person at a console, and adds nothing when standard input is closed; that first-run flow is not a verb and keeps its questions. The verb never prompts. Under a Store package the registry is virtualized and the package manifest declares the associations, so the verb is refused (exit 11, reason packaged), never a silent success. Served by doc-html-translate.exe only.
